normativeSource: CSS Grid Layout Module Level 1, 2025-03-26 CRD, section 7.2.1 Track Sizes
rule: When the grid container size depends on its tracks, percentages are treated as auto while calculating intrinsic container sizes, then resolved against the resulting inner size for final layout.

derivations.overflow: item extends 12px beyond its 12px column track
item extends 8px beyond its 8px row track

derivations.intrinsicBasis: not cyclic; explicit 40px inner inline size
derivations.overflow: item extends 4px beyond its 20px column track

limitations: No calc(), percentage minmax(), fit-content percentage, multiple percentage tracks, simultaneous cyclic columns and rows, nested Grid, writing mode variants, WPT, physical-device, or public CSS support claim.
